newsHighlights.title: Nation strengthening global outreach of TCM
newsHighlights.summary: China is stepping up efforts to share traditional Chinese medicine with the world, promoting holistic health and disease prevention.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国正加大力度向世界推广中医药，倡导整体健康与疾病预防理念。

newsHighlights.title: Xi: Prioritize ecological conservation
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping urged that ecological conservation be prioritized so that people can enjoy cleaner air, water and a healthier life.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席强调要优先推进生态保护，让人民群众享有更清洁的空气、更干净的水源和更健康的生活。

newsHighlights.title: Xi advances conservation with people at heart
newsHighlights.summary: Fish have returned to the once-dried Huangqihai Lake in Inner Mongolia, showing how ecological restoration improves both nature and public health.
newsHighlights.translation: 曾经干涸的内蒙古黄旗海重现鱼群，表明生态修复既能改善自然环境，也能增进公众健康。

newsHighlights.title: Yin Yuzhen plants a tree in FAO headquarters
newsHighlights.summary: Desert afforestation model Yin Yuzhen planted a tree at the FAO headquarters, symbolizing China's commitment to green and sustainable living.
newsHighlights.translation: 治沙造林模范殷玉珍在联合国粮农组织总部种下一棵树，象征着中国对绿色可持续生活的承诺。

newsHighlights.title: Red spirit spurs green growth
newsHighlights.summary: Marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March, young people are retracing the historic route on foot while promoting green, healthy lifestyles.
newsHighlights.translation: 值此长征胜利90周年之际，年轻人徒步重走长征路，同时倡导绿色健康的生活方式。

quote.quote: Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food.
quote.author: Hippocrates
quote.translation: 让食物成为你的药物，让药物成为你的食物。
quote.explanation: 这句出自“西方医学之父”希波克拉底的名言强调饮食对健康的根本作用，与今日新闻中中医药所倡导的“药食同源”“治未病”理念高度契合：真正的健康来自日常饮食与生活方式，而非等到生病后才治疗。

vocabulary.example: Herbal remedies are becoming popular among people seeking a natural way to stay healthy.
vocabulary.translation: 草药疗法正受到追求自然健康方式的人们欢迎。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 China Daily 报道《Nation strengthening global outreach of TCM》，文中介绍中草药（herbal medicine）等传统疗法走向世界。

vocabulary.example: Acupuncture is now practised in more than 190 countries and regions around the world.
vocabulary.translation: 针灸如今已在世界190多个国家和地区得到应用。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Nation strengthening global outreach of TCM》，报道指出针灸等中医疗法正加速走向海外。

vocabulary.example: A clean environment is closely linked to the well-being of the whole community.
vocabulary.translation: 洁净的环境与整个社区居民的身心健康密切相关。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Xi: Prioritize ecological conservation》，生态保护被视为提升人民生活福祉（well-being）的重要基础。

vocabulary.example: Ecological restoration has brought fish back to the once-dried Huangqihai Lake.
vocabulary.translation: 生态修复让曾经干涸的黄旗海重新出现了鱼群。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Xi advances conservation with people at heart》，报道描述黄旗海生态修复的成效。

vocabulary.example: The region is pursuing sustainable growth that benefits both nature and people.
vocabulary.translation: 该地区正在追求既有利于自然又惠及民众的可持续发展。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Red spirit spurs green growth》与《Yin Yuzhen plants a tree in FAO headquarters》，两篇报道均强调绿色可持续发展。

vocabulary.example: Restoring wetlands helps protect local biodiversity and improve air quality.
vocabulary.translation: 修复湿地有助于保护当地生物多样性并改善空气质量。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Xi advances conservation with people at heart》，湖泊与湿地修复带来物种回归，生物多样性明显提升。

vocabulary.definition: 呼吸的；与呼吸系统有关的
vocabulary.example: Poor air quality can lead to respiratory problems, especially among children and the elderly.
vocabulary.translation: 空气质量差可能引发呼吸系统疾病，儿童和老人尤其容易受影响。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联《Xi: Prioritize ecological conservation》报道：空气质量改善直接减少居民呼吸系统（respiratory）疾病。

vocabulary.example: Traditional Chinese medicine places great emphasis on prevention rather than cure.
vocabulary.translation: 中医药非常强调预防而非治疗。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Nation strengthening global outreach of TCM》，报道突出中医“治未病”的预防理念。

vocabulary.example: TCM takes a holistic view of the human body, treating the person rather than just the disease.
vocabulary.translation: 中医以整体观念看待人体，医治的是人而不仅仅是病。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Nation strengthening global outreach of TCM》，报道用 holistic 描述中医的整体诊疗理念。

vocabulary.example: The greening initiative has transformed large areas of desert into green woodland.
vocabulary.translation: 这项绿化倡议已把大片沙漠变成了绿色林地。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Yin Yuzhen plants a tree in FAO headquarters》，报道提及中国防治荒漠化的一系列绿化倡议（initiative）。

pattern.pattern: A is not merely X; it is Y.（A 不仅仅是 X，更是 Y）
pattern.example: Universities are not merely institutions that hand out degrees; they are epicenters of knowledge.
pattern.translation: 大学不仅仅是颁发学位的机构，更是知识的中心。
pattern.usage: 用于在肯定常见认知的基础上，强调事物更深层的价值或意义。写作与口语中可用于升华主题，如：Health is not merely the absence of disease; it is a state of complete physical and mental well-being.（健康不仅仅是没有疾病，更是身心俱佳的状态。）注意前后两句时态一致，分号后用代词 they/it 指代主语。

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）：过去动作对现在的影响
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时由 have/has + 过去分词构成，表示过去发生的动作对现在仍有影响或结果，常与 already、yet、so far、recently 等时间状语连用，且不与具体过去时间（如 last year）连用。今日新闻中多用该时态呈现生态治理与中医药推广的“阶段性成果”。
examples: Fish have returned to the Huangqihai Lake in Ulaanqab, Inner Mongolia autonomous region, which once dried up.
Traditional Chinese medicine has gained recognition in more than 190 countries and regions.

pronunciation.tips: 共四个音节：ac-u-punc-ture，重音在第一个音节 /ˈæk/。难点在 /kju/ 与 /ŋktʃ/：先发 /k/ 再快速滑向 /juː/（类似“Q”），随后 /pʌŋ/ 中 /ŋ/ 为鼻音，最后 /ktʃ/ 中 /k/ 要轻轻爆破并立刻接 /tʃ/（类似“吃”的声母）。整体节奏为“轻—轻—重—轻”，不要读成 a-cu-PUNC-ture。
examples: Acupuncture is now practised in more than 190 countries and regions.
She tried acupuncture to relieve the pain in her back.

reading.title: Healthy Living: Where Ancient Wisdom Meets a Greener World
reading.content:
As China strengthens the global outreach of traditional Chinese medicine, or TCM, more people around the world are discovering a holistic approach to health that values prevention rather than cure. Herbal remedies, acupuncture and qigong are now practised in over 190 countries and regions.

At the same time, ecological conservation is being prioritized. In Inner Mongolia, fish have returned to the once-dried Huangqihai Lake, and residents are enjoying cleaner air and water. Experts say a healthy environment is the foundation of public health, because fewer pollutants mean fewer respiratory problems.

Walking the historic Long March route has also become a popular way for young Chinese to stay fit while learning about history. Whether through ancient remedies or green living, the message is the same: good health is not merely the absence of disease — it depends on balance, both within the body and around it.
reading.translation:
随着中国加快中医药走向世界，全球越来越多的人开始了解一种注重“治未病”而非治疗的整体健康理念。草药、针灸和气功如今已在190多个国家和地区得到应用。

与此同时，生态保护被置于优先位置。在内蒙古，曾经干涸的黄旗海重现鱼群，居民享受到更清洁的空气和水源。专家指出，健康的环境是公共健康的根基，因为污染物越少，呼吸系统疾病就越少。

徒步重走长征路也成为中国年轻人在了解历史的同时强身健体的热门方式。无论是古老的养生疗法还是绿色生活，道理都一样：健康不仅仅是没有疾病，它取决于平衡——既在于身体内部，也在于我们周围的世界。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 China Daily 当日真实报道《Nation strengthening global outreach of TCM》《Xi: Prioritize ecological conservation》《Xi advances conservation with people at heart》及《Red spirit spurs green growth》改写与整合，用于英语学习目的。
